cause: Default ArtifactStore payload reads now use one bounded descriptor read. Six growth fault cases and one signed-digest case still used the former default three-read contract. Genuine custom integrity hooks retain their original three reads.
repair: Exercise all six original phase/size growth faults through a genuine delegating integrity override.
Preserve exact hook order, frozen shared limits, bounded chunks, EOF probes, signed digests, descriptor close and index-mutation checks.
Add default single-read success, expected/max growth before content reads, growth after descriptor admission, and same-size signed-byte tampering cases.

publication.required: New exact final release commit CLI CI, CLI Strict Sandbox, full original formal reliability and IDE gates; required child npm packages before CLI, then IDE extensions. Previous SHA checks do not qualify the new release commit.
